name: smartpark
description: Original SmartPark web platform and parking services

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @smartpark/api" "npm run dev --workspace @smartpark/web"
scripts.test:vision: cd services/vision && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:vision
scripts.deploy:build: npm run preflight:production && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml build api web
scripts.deploy:up: npm run preflight:production && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml build api web && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml up -d db && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm api npm run migrate && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml up -d api web caddy email-worker
scripts.deploy:vision: npm run deploy:up && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml --profile vision up -d --build vision
scripts.verify:release: npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run test:integration
